claim: Previous-day performers, premarket gaps and30day leaders feed strength lists; emerging groups matter.
impact_on_spec: Causal observations keyed by decision date; rank relative strength, dollar turnover and group upgrades; list is not entry.
limitations: Scanner percentiles and sector clustering are local hypotheses. Missing historical group labels disable group-score contribution, not fill with future themes.
quote: On weekends, I also scan for the biggest movers of the past 30 days

claim: HighADR preference, stop generally<=halfADR and1-5%; ADR>5% not a hard filter.
impact_on_spec: ADR20 and volume are trailing only; soft score rather than a universalADR>5 rejection.
limitations: 20day window and relative scoring are adaptation, no claim original fixed formula.

claim: Chop/declining breadth/failed followthrough lead to less trading; speculation weakness need not mean whole market weakness.
impact_on_spec: QQQ/IWM state plus trailing own closed-trade evidence; do not infer regime from current trade future.
limitations: Index-state/breadth proxy and feedback thresholds must be tested separately. General index never substitutes actual theme state.

claim: Within-base or first retest with higher lows preferred; extended supportless entries and weak downtrends cited as failures.
impact_on_spec: Confirmed pivots have explicit recognition time; base age/depth/contraction measured before session; first touch counter.
limitations: Exact age/depth/contraction cutoffs are ours, not trader rules. Do not retrospectively move base beginning.

claim: Base swing extrema and high-volume gap anchors; speaker also adjusts anchors to prior price respect.
impact_on_spec: <=3 known anchor candidates; pivot recognition delay; rank by past-only support/rejection touches, freeze before decision.
limitations: Retrospective chart adjustment is not itself a causal profitable rule. Ranking surrogate tested vs fixed anchor and noAVWAP; no post-trigger or future-return anchor choice.

claim: EMA/AVWAP/prior swing levels together form potential support; lower timeframe execution distinguishes setup from trigger.
impact_on_spec: Support clusters scaled by trailingADR; wick touch then reclaim; stale/future support rejected.
limitations: Confluence radius and support count are local adaptations; not EMA-only system.

claim: Previous completed lower-timeframe bar-high breakout; early1minute and later5minute tactics; LOD or bar-low stop varies with width.
impact_on_spec: First15minutes use1m completed bars, minutes15-60 use5m, minutes60-120 use15m; intent known only at completed bar end, next-minute market/capped order.
limitations: 60-120 use15m and fixed two-hour cutoff are bounded adaptations; transcript first15minute wording is noisy. Completed-close trigger delays source live crossing; prearmed crossing evaluated separately only with native adapter.

claim: Stop defined before entry; hard stop after fill. Planned percent risk is distinct from stock stop distance.
impact_on_spec: Choose LOD when valid<=halfADR, otherwise prior completed confirmation-bar low; floor tick; freeze quantity and initialR before fill.
limitations: The breakout-bar future low cannot size a prearmed order. Gap losses and fees can exceed plannedR; no clipping.

claim: Reentry caught winners but frequent attempts caused long losing streaks; market condition matters.
impact_on_spec: Stopout requires fresh support visit and new completed confirmation; cumulative attempts/costs retained per epoch and session.
limitations: 3/day and8/epoch are research protection hypotheses, not original thresholds. All rejected attempts logged.

claim: Longs may trim strength and follow9EMA or stop below it; premature discretionary full sale also acknowledged.
impact_on_spec: Initial hard stop plus daily-close9EMA exit queued next observed session; optional15%3R trim neutral market; strong-market no trim; no weak-followthrough after2sessions exit.
limitations: Neutral/strong definitions,2session time stop and partial schedule are adaptation. Hold until real exit; no EOD force-flat; open tail marked, not liquidated terminally.

claim: Shorts quick swings;15%>3R and support trims; hourly50EMA/extension exit, not weeks-long home run.
impact_on_spec: Separate short-side model interface; requires actualETB/borrow/SSR before economic short strategy.
limitations: Not executed in this first long implementation. Old four-case short grid stays closed. Short component not claimed absent from original performance.

claim: Long losing streaks/drawdown led to smaller initial size and progressive exposure.
impact_on_spec: Risk0.125%-0.5% from own prior completed trades and currentNAV; caps at35%name/100%gross/2%initial aggregate risk; monthly new-entry risk room5%.
limitations: Caps and finite-state transitions are local test policies; no realized NAV floor or claim trader used identical controller.

claim: Breakout and news EP are different source setups; news catalyst and unexpected revaluation matter to EP.
impact_on_spec: Matched breakout comparator; no price-only gap called faithfulEP. Retain separate EP dependency pendingPIT catalyst packets.
limitations: OriginalQullamaggie3-5day trim is not Martin15%3R; source versions never fused as universal rule.

claim: Repeated scale-in/out on resistant vehicle accumulated140k selfreportedloss.
impact_on_spec: Stop/reentry friction and nonfollowing opportunities count in joint account; wrong vehicle selection can dominate timing.
limitations: Anecdote challenges all-bounce and unlimited-reentry inference; does not establish population null or exact loss distribution.
